name: Catalog Personalization
tagline: Help businesses personalize their categories and products to specific User Groups

readme.overview: The Catalog Personalization module enables the personalization of catalogs through the use of User Groups. This module allows catalog objects such as products and categories to be assigned to User Groups, and different policies for User Group propagation in the catalog objects hierarchy can be defined.
keyFeatures: **Catalog visibility personalization**: Control who sees what in your storefront with the Catalog Personalization module.
**Flexible User Group propagation**: Choose the propagation policy that works best for your catalog hierarchy with the User Group Propagation Policies feature.
**Filtering with User Groups**: Improve storefront search results by assigning User Groups to Product Categories with the User Groups for Products or Categories Filtration feature.
**Efficient User Group assignment**: Save time and effort with the Assign User Groups feature, allowing you to easily create and assign User Groups to Catalog Objects.

notes.forAnalyst: Showing different products to different shoppers — by segment, behaviour or membership.
notes.forArchitect: Three entities, nine migrations, and **two index document builders**: personalisation is projected into the search index rather than evaluated per request, which is what makes it survive storefront traffic. Three dependencies only.
notes.forDeveloper: Tagging drives the index, so a personalisation change needs a reindex to become visible — the trade-off for its speed. Two declared events tell you when that is needed.
reachForItWhen: Different audiences should see different catalogues
Segments already exist in customer data and should drive merchandising
Personalised results must be as fast as ordinary search
doNotReachForItWhen: A single promotion covers it — Marketing is lighter
You need per-request personalisation with no index delay
Segments are not defined: this module applies them, it does not invent them
